overflow_observed_bytes_lower_bound: The drainer counts all bytes returned by the cap-crossing read; it never invents unread pipe bytes.
drain_incomplete_snapshot: A bounded join failure leaves raw pins NULL and fails. The invocation JSON and returned value are copied under the cause lock; a late daemon drainer cannot change sealed facts.
drain_join_failure_behavior: Thread start/join failure is recorded once; incomplete drains keep raw pins NULL. The bounded parent does not treat an unstarted worker as a successful drain.
raw_stream_completion_contract: EOF plus sealed exact raw pin per stdout/stderr. Cap crossing saves at most a partial raw pin and never exposes it as a complete raw stream; roster and lane fail closed.
